description: CPU-instruction baselines for batch_charge at 100 and 500 subscriptions. Fail if measured cost exceeds baseline by more than tolerance_pct.

batch_100_all_chargeable.note: Populate with the measured value from the first passing run, then tighten tolerance_pct to 10.0.

batch_500_all_chargeable.note: Populate with the measured value from the first passing run.

batch_100_half_insufficient.note: 50 subscriptions have zero balance; 50 are chargeable.

batch_500_half_insufficient.note: 250 subscriptions have zero balance; 250 are chargeable.
